## GMS1 for your daughter

Use block capitals on the paper form. After mdoc restores the values, check whether any letters need to be capitalized by hand.

| Box | What to enter |
| --- | --- |
| B01 Title | NEEDS-YOU. Tick the title she uses. |
| B02 Surname | SURNAME_P3 |
| B03 Date of birth | DATE_P3 |
| B04 First names | GIVEN_P3 |
| B05 NHS number | NEEDS-YOU. Enter her NHS number if known. |
| B06 Previous surnames | NEEDS-YOU. Enter any previous surnames, or leave blank if she has had none. |
| B07 Sex | Tick **Female**. |
| B08 Town and country of birth | PLACE_P3 |
| B09 Home address | ADDRESS_P1 |
| B10 Postcode | Copy the postcode from the restored home address into this box by hand. If the address does not include it, NEEDS-YOU for the postcode. |
| B11 Telephone | PHONE_P1 |
| B12 Previous UK address | NEEDS-YOU. Enter a previous UK address if relevant to tracing her medical records. |
| B13–B14 Previous doctor’s name and address | Leave blank. This is her first GP registration. |
| B15 First UK address where registered with a GP | If the “from abroad” section applies, use the address from B09 for this first registration. |
| B16 Date of leaving the UK | NEEDS-YOU. Enter the date only if she previously lived in the UK and then left. |
| B17 Date she first came to live in the UK | NEEDS-YOU if she moved to the UK from abroad. Enter the date she first came to live here. |
| B18–B20 Armed Forces details | Leave blank if the Armed Forces section does not apply. If it does, NEEDS-YOU for her address before enlisting, service or personnel number, and enlistment date. |
| B21 Child Health Surveillance | Tick only if she is under five and you want her registered for it. NEEDS-YOU to confirm both. |
| B22 Dispensing | Leave unticked unless she needs the GP to dispense medicines or appliances. If she does, NEEDS-YOU to confirm which statement applies. |
| B23 Signature | Tick **Signature on behalf of patient** and sign by hand. |
| B24 Date | NEEDS-YOU. Enter the date you sign. |

For B08, check that the restored birthplace includes both the town and the country. If either is missing, NEEDS-YOU to add it by hand. B11 uses your phone number as her parent contact.
